scene: The metal bird chirps cheerfully, projecting a vibrant city transit map.
picture: A flat side view along the rooftop catwalk platform. On the far left, a small wooden rowing boat rests in a flooded runoff chute. The curly-haired boy in a denim jacket stands left of centre smiling at the mechanical bird. At centre right, an open freight lift waits. On the far right sits an electric golf-cart.

an open metal freight lift cage waiting with lit buttons centre right
